hooks.name: Keep tasks.md checkboxes in sync
hooks.description: After a spec task finishes, remind the agent to update .kiro/specs/fly-brain-horror/tasks.md honestly.

action.prompt: A spec task just finished. Update .kiro/specs/fly-brain-horror/tasks.md so its checkboxes match reality: tick a sub-task only if it is implemented and verified (pytest passes and `python -m content.validate` reports 0 errors); tick a parent task only when all its sub-tasks are ticked. Never tick tasks marked 👤 (they need the user), and never tick deployment tasks (17.x) unless they were tested on the live server. If the work changed a requirement or the design, update requirements.md or design.md in the same Chinese style. Reply with the list of boxes you changed.
